protocol: Paired baseline/candidate calls on fresh Data; small warmup; median of repeats. Includes Data construction and all selected measures. Peak memory is a separate tracemalloc run (NumPy allocations, not process RSS). PSI deliberately changes the baseline definition: adjacent native FFT bins and inclusive band edges. Its correctness is independently checked in tests/unit/test_psi.py; other measures are required to match the baseline.

numerical_checks.comparison: intentional PSI definition change; see tests/unit/test_psi.py
intentional PSI definition change; see tests/unit/test_psi.py

full_spectral.command: .venv/bin/python -B -m pytest tests/regression/test_spi_goldens.py --pyspi-size=full --runslow --require-java -k 'multitaper or sgc or catalogue' --tb=short -q --disable-warnings

validation.golden_scope: Only three psi_multitaper matrices and their SPI records changed in each small/full set; all other 282 matrices and SPI records per set are unchanged. Partial regeneration provenance is recorded separately.

definition.reference: Nolte et al. (2008), PRL 100, 234101, equation 3 (raw PSI)
definition.frequency_pairing: adjacent existing FFT bins; no bandwidth/50 thinning
definition.band_edges: both inclusive; DC and Nyquist included when requested
definition.insufficient_bins: ValueError for fewer than two selected bins; Calculator stores NaN with failed MetricReport and reason
definition.remaining_review: Window duration/multitaper smoothing, sign/direction classifications, wavelet PSI, and other spectral definitions are unchanged.
